# Permanent Arabic scene signage

Generated with Pillow and Noto Sans Arabic (SIL OFL 1.1), using RAQM shaping when available. Original Latin sign assets remain preserved. Map signage is independent of the UI language switch. Brand transliteration: أوريل وفينش للمجوهرات (Aurel & Finch). Atlas UV rectangles remain unchanged; painting cells are retained.

Crime-scene print is weathered in the texture, repeated in physical metres, and oriented separately on both tape faces. Main store/environment signage remains Arabic independently of UI language. As requested, original payment logos, selected advertisements/posters and graffiti retain their native-language artwork. Generator: Tools/make_arabic_signs.py; dependencies Pillow, numpy, arabic-reshaper and python-bidi. The unchanged original WallGraphics cells preserve their original attribution.
